title: macros
rule: Let users compose a sequence of smaller actions into one reusable macro.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Doing Things — Macros (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: A sequence of smaller actions can be composed into one reusable macro.
fail_when: Repeated sequences cannot be recorded or reused as a macro.
overview: Users can compose smaller actions into one reusable macro sequence.
apply_when: People repeat the same multi-step action sequence often.
not_when: One-off flows that will not be replayed as a saved sequence.
agent_hint: Let users record or compose repeated steps into a reusable macro.
description: Macros let people compose a sequence of smaller actions into one reusable command. When repeated sequences cannot be recorded or reused, experts waste time redoing the same multi-step work. Offer composition where repetition is common so one invocation replaces the chain. Skip macro machinery for paths that are never replayed and would only add complexity.
